issues.problem: Label "Save changes" does not match the row action "Archive this repository".
issues.fix: Change label to "Archive this repository" or equivalent.
issues.verdict: The button label 'Save changes' describes a generic form action while the row describes the destructive action 'Archive this repository', so the label does not name the action the row performs.

issues.problem: Icon link-external suggests opening another page, conflicting with delete action.
issues.fix: Replace link-external icon with trash icon.
issues.verdict: The link-external octicon signals navigation to another page, but the button performs a destructive delete action; a trash icon would match the action semantics.

issues.problem: Primary button used for Cancel action, which should not be primary.
issues.fix: Change variant to default (or secondary) for Cancel.
issues.verdict: The primary button is labeled "Cancel" while the form's main action "Submit new issue" appears as a sibling, violating the rule that the primary button must be the main form action, never Cancel.

rejected.problem: Label "Title" contradicts the row which shows the actual pull request title.
rejected.fix: Display the pull request title instead of the static word "Title".
rejected.verdict: The Pagehead label 'Title' is a placeholder that does not match the actual PR title 'Add size xsmall to Button #4821' shown in the row.

rejected.problem: Primary button labeled 'Merge pull request' conflicts with the row indicating unresolved conflicts; the main action to advance is 'Resolve conflicts'.
rejected.fix: Change the button variant to secondary (or make 'Resolve conflicts' the primary button).
rejected.verdict: The row text 'Some checks were not successful | 2 of 3 checks passed · ds-sync failing' signals the merge cannot proceed, so the primary action should be 'Resolve conflicts' rather than a disabled 'Merge pull request'.
